name: Athaliah
charge: Destroying the seed royal of Judah; usurping the throne
summary: Ahab's daughter, married into Judah's line, saw her son Ahaziah dead at Jehu's hand and murdered all the seed royal to reign herself. One infant, Joash, was hidden in the house of the Lord for six years. In the seventh, Jehoiada the priest brought him out.
offense: Mass murder of her own grandchildren for a crown, and six years of Baal worship in Jerusalem: her sons had broken up the house of God and given its dedicated things to Baalim.
judgment: She heard the trumpets, rent her clothes, and cried, treason. Jehoiada would not have her killed in the house of the Lord; they took her out by the horse gate and slew her there. Then the people tore down Baal's house and killed Mattan his priest.
